name: discord-calculus-teaching-platform
description: Monorepo command surface for the fixture-first teaching support prototype

scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/**/*.{astro,css,ts,json}" package.json && python -m ruff format bots tools tests runtime/discord-course-bots/src runtime/discord-course-bots/tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/**/*.{astro,css,ts,json}" package.json && python -m ruff format --check bots tools tests runtime/discord-course-bots/src runtime/discord-course-bots/tests
scripts.lint: python -m ruff check bots tools tests runtime/discord-course-bots/src runtime/discord-course-bots/tests
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.check: npm run secrets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
